openings.claim: Return to the home screen and obtain the visitor's language choice before handoff; require menu state, requested language and battery readiness jointly.
openings.discriminator: The paired steps may outperform either alone if inherited menu state causes delays: synthetically, nine of 36 green handsets played the previous language and eight exceeded one minute.
openings.probe: Compare paired steps, reset alone, advance choice alone and existing practice across matched requests. Measure requested-language playback within one minute and average return time; stop above 30 seconds.
openings.uncertainty: Untested effects; reset reliability, reset impact on charge indication, independent submenu contribution and queue overlap remain unknown. Choice must be communicated without retaining visitor data. Synthetic home-screen selection took 12–22 seconds; charge-only returns averaged eight seconds.

openings.claim: Combine language-specific positions in the existing dock with a visible check of actual menu settings; location and verified setting jointly supplement charge readiness.
openings.discriminator: The pair may outperform grouping alone when location cues remain accurate. Uneven demand could erase benefits; synthetic choices spanned three options and four green handsets remained on submenus.
openings.probe: Compare paired steps with grouping alone under equal and uneven demand. Measure handoff success, return time and admission interference; stop if admission is delayed or histories retained.
openings.uncertainty: Dock marking feasibility, cue accuracy and setting checks' admission capacity cost are untested.

lineage.reason: Preserves paired readiness conditions and separate-step comparisons.
Preserves location-setting conjunction and demand dependence.

decision: Both are probe candidates, supported only by synthetic stipulations. Require at least 95% requested-language playback within one minute during the stipulated entrance period. Preserve twelve handsets and dock, admission responsibility with the existing attendant, no visitor identities or persisted histories, and average returns no longer than 30 seconds.
